description: This source file defines the WarningPanel class, a UI component managing warning and error messages display within the application. It handles displaying messages, blinking on fatal errors, and clearing warnings.

classes.name: WarningPanel
classes.description: A Swing UI component that displays warning and error messages, with special handling for fatal errors by blinking a label.

methods.name: WarningPanel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the warning panel, sets up message listener, and UI components.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the warning message and disables the reset button.

methods.name: getPanel
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel containing the warning UI components.
